findings.title: Add coverage for CA directory verification
findings.why_it_matters: The changed request-context path now passes directory-valued verify settings as ca_cert_dir. Existing integration coverage exercises a custom CA bundle file, but no test supplies a CA directory, so a regression in this newly added branch could break a documented verify form without detection.
findings.suggested_fix: Add a TLS integration test using a hashed CA directory containing the test CA, assert verification succeeds for its issued server certificate, and assert an unrelated/untrusted certificate still fails.

findings.title: Test reuse of the preloaded default SSL context
findings.why_it_matters: The optimization's central behavior is that verify=True requests reuse a single SSLContext whose default bundle was loaded once. Existing tests exercise verify=True rejection of an untrusted server, but do not assert that requests share this context or avoid per-request CA loading; a change that restores repeated loading could pass the current suite while losing the stated performance improvement.
findings.suggested_fix: Add focused adapter/context coverage showing repeated verify=True request-context construction returns the same ssl_context object, and that cert_verify does not assign CA paths or trigger additional load_verify_locations calls for this path.

residual_risks: The existing integration tests cover verify=False, verify=True rejection of an untrusted server, and custom CA bundle files; this review did not execute tests.
testing_gaps: No test covers a custom CA directory supplied through verify.
No test asserts module-level SSLContext identity/reuse or guards against repeated default CA loading.
